entries.title: Proverbs 7:1
segments: ¶My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:2
segments: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:3
segments: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:4
segments: Say unto wisdom, Thou [art] my sister; and call understanding [thy] kinswoman:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:5
segments: That they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger [which] flattereth with her words.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:6
segments: ¶For at the window of my house I looked through my casement,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:7
segments: And beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the youths, a young man void of understanding, {the youths: Heb. the sons}

entries.title: Proverbs 7:8
segments: Passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:9
segments: In the twilight, in the evening, in the black and dark night: {in the evening: Heb. in the evening of days}

words.text: : {in the evening: Heb. in the evening of days}

entries.title: Proverbs 7:10
segments: And, behold, there met him a woman [with] the attire of an harlot, and subtil of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:11
segments: (She [is] loud and stubborn; her feet abide not in her house:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:12
segments: Now [is she] without, now in the streets, and lieth in wait at every corner.)

entries.title: Proverbs 7:13
segments: So she caught him, and kissed him, [and] with an impudent face said unto him, {with...: Heb. she strengthened her face and said}

words.text: unto him, {with...: Heb. she strengthened her face and said}

entries.title: Proverbs 7:14
segments: [I have] peace offerings with me; this day have I payed my vows. {I have...: Heb. Peace offerings are upon me}

words.text: . {I have...: Heb. Peace offerings are upon me}

entries.title: Proverbs 7:15
segments: Therefore came I forth to meet thee, diligently to seek thy face, and I have found thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:16
segments: I have decked my bed with coverings of tapestry, with carved [works], with fine linen of Egypt.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:17
segments: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:18
segments: Come, let us take our fill of love until the morning: let us solace ourselves with loves.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:19
segments: For the goodman [is] not at home, he is gone a long journey:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:20
segments: He hath taken a bag of money with him, [and] will come home at the day appointed. {with...: Heb. in his hand} {the day...: or, the new moon}

words.text: . {with...: Heb. in his hand} {the day...: or, the new moon}

entries.title: Proverbs 7:21
segments: With her much fair speech she caused him to yield, with the flattering of her lips she forced him.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:22
segments: He goeth after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, or as a fool to the correction of the stocks; {straightway: Heb. suddenly}

entries.title: Proverbs 7:23
segments: Till a dart strike through his liver; as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it [is] for his life.

words.text: not that it [is] for his life

entries.title: Proverbs 7:24
segments: ¶Hearken unto me now therefore, O ye children, and attend to the words of my mouth.

words.text: unto me now therefore, O ye children

entries.title: Proverbs 7:25
segments: Let not thine heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:26
segments: For she hath cast down many wounded: yea, many strong [men] have been slain by her.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:27
segments: Her house [is] the way to hell, going down to the chambers of death.
